visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white sleeveless shirt and black shorts stands on a red basketball court holding a red microphone. He speaks energetically, gesturing with his hands toward the camera while yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom and center. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor area with trees. The same man is now wearing a long brown wig and a fake muscle-suit arm, standing beside a young woman in a pink shirt and white shorts who is wearing a paper mask of his face. He speaks with exaggerated hand movements. (3) The man appears on a red running track wearing a black t-shirt and an inflatable dinosaur-bottom costume, carrying a book titled 'Super Dinosaur'. He points upwards while smiling broadly at the camera. (4) Three men stand in front of a concrete building: one with a tall white wig and arm sleeve tattoos, one with a yellow spiky wig, and one with a black afro wig. They all wear white shirts with sleeve tattoos and perform synchronized gestures. (5) A person wearing a long blonde wig, a white t-shirt, and a black skirt sits on concrete stairs outdoors. Next to them is a portable gas stove and a metal pot containing food. The camera pans closer as the person eats with chopsticks. (6) The man from phase 1 is seen in a bathroom, applying clear gel from a white bottle to his palms and then massaging his face. He looks into the camera with a neutral then smiling expression. (7) Three skincare bottles are showcased on green grass under natural light. Close-up shots follow, showing the details of the 'Vitamin B Cleanser', 'PDRN Collagen Ampoule', and 'RG Blue Pepti Serum'. (8) A split-screen comparison shows 'Before' on the left and 'After' on the right of the man's face, highlighting improvements in skin texture and brightness. (9) The man, wearing the blonde wig again, stands in a room with a brown wardrobe background, smiling and gesturing towards the camera to recommend the products.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator (Jam Steak) playing multiple roles, 1 female student interviewee, and 2 additional male actors in the cosplay scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male creator with short black hair, often wearing a white sleeveless t-shirt, also seen in various costumes including a dinosaur inflatable, multiple wigs (brown, blonde, anime-style), and muscle suits.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a basketball court with red surfacing, a track and field with a grass center, concrete campus stairs, a white-tiled bathroom, and a room with wooden closets.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal greeting set against a fast-tempo electronic pop beat. The vocal pitch is high and delivery is rapid. (2) A transition whoosh triggers a new phase as the speaker interviews a female student; his voice remains animated but the tempo of speech slows slightly to accommodate dialogue. (3) A digital 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of the dinosaur character; the music swells with a synth lead, maintaining a bright, major-key tonality. (4) Loud anime-style sound effects and synthesized impact noises occur as the cosplayers speak with a deep, dramatic vocal intensity. (5) A rhythmic 'thud' and a bubble SFX transition to the blonde-wig character; the background music shifts to a playful, bouncy comedy-style track. (6) The acoustic texture becomes cleaner and more 'studio-like' as a professional, narrative-style male voice begins describing skincare benefits. (7) Sound of liquid splashing and a soft spray hiss are clearly audible over a gentle melodic piano and synth pad background. (8) The video concludes with a friendly, high-arousal vocal recommendation and a final musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Comedic Search -> Product Reveal -> Benefits/Demo -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Orgahue' skincare products through a humorous and engaging street-interview style skit that transitions into a personal review and product demonstration.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, listing of ingredients/benefits (Vitamin B, PDRN, Blue Pepti), and a final verbal recommendation with an IG handle for the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A fast-paced social media promotional video that uses high-arousal comedy and varied character roles to maintain attention before delivering a structured skincare advertisement.
